evals.prompt: I'm a science teacher at a Thai Waldorf school and I've just installed the thai-waldorf-science plugin. How does the whole design and teaching process work, from start to finish?
evals.expected_output: The fixed walkthrough of the whole process in order, without first asking questions or looking for files, ending by asking where the teacher is.
expectations: The reply walks through the process in this order: describe the class (setting-up-class-profiles), map the curriculum (mapping-curriculum), plan a main lesson block or a subject lesson (planning-main-lesson-blocks / planning-subject-lessons), write the Thai core plan (writing-thai-core-plans), then differentiation, formative assessment and the epistemic agency audit, and finally preparing to teach (preparing-to-teach)

The reply names all of these skills: setting-up-class-profiles, mapping-curriculum, planning-main-lesson-blocks, planning-subject-lessons, writing-thai-core-plans, differentiating-for-learner-variability, planning-formative-assessment, auditing-epistemic-agency, preparing-to-teach
The reply gives the walkthrough straight away rather than asking clarifying questions first
The reply contains no file paths, tool names or other technical jargon aimed at developers (skill names are allowed)
The reply ends by asking where the teacher currently is in the process
